deletionRationale: Additive reserved boundary with no current production SDK manifest reader or dynamic guest route; XSDK0 deletes nothing. Displaced first-party routes keep their CAT0 cutover owners: CPF1 for the catalog container and hard-coded registrations (CAT-D01, CAT-D02, CAT-D03, D06), COX0 for the provider-gate index (CAT-D06) and LNT3 for RuleRegistry (CAT-D05). Editor/provider adapters keep their owners.

conditions: E01: One exact manifest, dependency and target release tuple with core-minted provenance and digest
E02: Exact admission compatibility; grants and host cells decide participation, not registration
E03: Deterministic conflict rejection and immutable snapshot replacement
E04: Typed fact and rule-row validation without semantic or rule-execution authority
E05: Explicit trust, mediated capabilities and qualified bounded isolation; no guest rule-body evaluation
E06: Demand-selected execution with live-basis checks and teardown
E07: Canonical authored transactions with preconditions and execution grants
E08: Local inspectable delivery and real host/profile/example evidence

conditionJustifications.condition: E01: One exact manifest, dependency and target release tuple with core-minted provenance and digest
conditionJustifications.prevents: Incompatible releases, unresolved dependencies or forged official-static provenance admitted through package metadata; plausible on the first unvalidated guest integration.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Static first-party providers do not negotiate external manifest versions or mint T09 provenance

conditionJustifications.condition: E02: Exact admission compatibility; grants and host cells decide participation, not registration
conditionJustifications.prevents: Unknown protocols executing by fallback, or grant state and process facilities changing snapshot membership and identity against CAT0 CR06/CR11; plausible on the first guest integration that checks grants.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: No current SDK admission implementation exercises this boundary, and CAT0's catalog rules have no grant input to reject

conditionJustifications.condition: E03: Deterministic conflict rejection and immutable snapshot replacement
conditionJustifications.prevents: Discovery order selects duplicate owners or mutates live registration; plausible on the first unvalidated guest integration.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Catalog invariants need enforcement at the new external ingress

conditionJustifications.condition: E04: Typed fact and rule-row validation without semantic or rule-execution authority
conditionJustifications.prevents: Untrusted metadata impersonates a type/resolver answer, or a contributed rule row gains a second, unowned rule executor beside LRA0's native/LNT2 dispositions; plausible when XK06 is read as an executable rule cell.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: First-party fact producers are not untrusted payload validators, and the rule-owner contract is CI-inert prose

conditionJustifications.condition: E05: Explicit trust, mediated capabilities and qualified bounded isolation; no guest rule-body evaluation
conditionJustifications.prevents: Ordinary guest code inherits ambient filesystem, network or origin access, or runs third-party rule bodies in a guest; plausible on the first unvalidated guest integration.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Worker and subprocess lifecycle alone do not enforce a guest sandbox or a rule-execution boundary

conditionJustifications.condition: E06: Demand-selected execution with live-basis checks and teardown
conditionJustifications.prevents: Delayed guest replies publish after edits, upgrades or cancellation; plausible on the first unvalidated guest integration.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Core validity cannot observe undeclared extension dependencies

conditionJustifications.condition: E07: Canonical authored transactions with preconditions and execution grants
conditionJustifications.prevents: Guest edits write stale or unmappable generated coordinates; plausible on the first unvalidated guest integration.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Existing transaction checks only protect proposals that enter their owner

conditionJustifications.condition: E08: Local inspectable delivery and real host/profile/example evidence
conditionJustifications.prevents: Contract or upstream capability is published as implemented support; plausible on the first unvalidated guest integration.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Generic CI success cannot qualify missing SDK host cells or examples
